findings.source_quote: She had a government ticket on all Finnish state railways and took a general oversight not only of those in ward but of discharged prisoners, also, and of the families of prisoners both in duress and discharged.
findings.suggested_fix: 将“普遍照料在押人员”改为“全面关照在押人员”，以表达她对他们承担广泛照料责任，而非通常意义上的普遍性。
